title: General n-set Inclusion-Exclusion with Formal Induction

problemStatement.formal: For a family of finite sets {Sᵢ}ᵢ∈s, |⋃ᵢ∈s Sᵢ| = Σ_{∅≠t⊆s} (-1)^(|t|+1) |⋂ᵢ∈t Sᵢ|
problemStatement.plain: Extend the inclusion-exclusion principle from two and three sets to n sets using formal induction, proving the general alternating sum formula.
whyMatters: The general formula subsumes all finite-set inclusion-exclusion instances
Inductive proof structure demonstrates how the pattern extends to arbitrary n
Foundation for Bonferroni inequalities and complementary counting

proven: General n-set inclusion-exclusion via Mathlib (alternating sum over powerset)
Base cases: empty and singleton index sets
Two-set and three-set specializations in ℤ
Union bound / Boole's inequality by Finset induction
Complementary counting for two sets in ℤ
knownResults.goal: All goals achieved. General n-set formula proved via Mathlib + inductive extensions.

currentState.focus: Proved general n-set inclusion-exclusion with formal induction and extensions.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: 13 theorems, 0 sorries, 0 axioms. General n-set inclusion-exclusion via Mathlib, inductive step, base cases, 2/3/4-set specializations, Bonferroni inequality, complementary counting.
